text:
Aisha: Heads-up: PR #4620 updates Console observability docs — adds a compact dashboard preset for cost/latency breakdowns and rewrites trace hook examples for the `trace_id` rename. Need someone to run linkcheck and verify snippet formatting. @DevEx Mike?
DevEx Mike: I can take this. Paste the staging preview please.
Aisha: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4620. Main changes: new widget preset (cost-by-route + latency heatmap), trace hook param renamed, and small Node/Python snippet tweaks. Also a doc redirect for the old tracehook deep-dive.
Ravi (eng): FYI runtime v2.0 had a compat layer, but recommend calling out that older agent versions (<2.0) will need explicit snippet updates.
Ops Lin: Can infra run a quick microbench for the dashboard sample numbers? Product wants before/after numbers for the preset doc blurb.
Tori (product): Yes please. Suggested blurb: "Median latency: 140ms -> 110ms, p99: 320ms -> 280ms, estimated cost/unit: $0.0051 -> $0.0044" (approx). Include a caveat: results vary.
DevEx Mike: Running docs smoke + linkcheck: ```./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4620 --linkcheck```
doc-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4620 -> staging
DevEx Mike: Smoke passed. Linkcheck found 1 broken anchor (tracehook-deepdive#examples). Left PR comment.
Aisha: I'll patch the anchor and add a short migration snippet mapping old key to new key in JS/Python.
Ravi (eng): Snippet suggestion for JS: ```js
// old
span.setTag('traceKey', ctx.traceKey)
// new
span.setTag('trace_id', ctx.trace_id)
``` For Python: ```py
# old
span.tags['traceKey'] = ctx['traceKey']
# new
span.tags['trace_id'] = ctx['trace_id']
```
DevEx Mike: Pushed snippet fix (commit d4f9c2). Also formatted the dashboard numbers into a small table so it renders in the preset docs.
Ops Lin: Microbench (summary): median down ~21%, p99 down ~12%, token cost per request down ~14%. Adding a line in the preset: "Microbench observed improvements; your workload may differ."
Tori (product): Perfect. Add a one-liner migration checklist: 1) Upgrade SDKs to v3.4+ for auto-mapping; 2) If on older SDKs, replace `traceKey` with `trace_id` in traces/dashboards.
Aisha: Added checklist, patched link, and requested reviews from @DevEx Mike, @Ravi (eng), and @Ops Lin. Aiming to merge today.
DevEx Mike: LGTM once CI finishes and link is green.
doc-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 4620 -> staging (status: success)
Aisha: Merged to main and backported to 3.x docs. Closing thread — thanks all.
Tori (product): Nice, smooth turnaround :tada:
